fulfillmentMethod.description: The fulfillment method on item to fetch rates for. Supported values are Ship and Delivery. Will assume Ship if nothing is passed.

productSummaries.description: If Product Summaries are populated, this information will be utilized in Product Rules (e.g. ProductCode eq "ABC" or (Weight.Unit eq "lbs" and Weight.Value ge 50)

resolvedShippingZoneCode.description:
Resolved Shipping Zone Code.  This value can be null if the tenant/site does not have shipping zones defined or there are no matching 
shipping zones for the request (e.g. the only zone defined is "UNITED-STATES" and the destination address of the rate request is in Canada)

carrierAccountNumber.description:
Optional shipper-provided carrier account number. When provided, postage is
billed to this account using SENDER billing via EasyPost options.payment,
overriding any stored-credential billing for this request. Not persisted in
Kibo; masked (last 4) in logs.

consolidationReferences.description: Consolidation references for Order Number, Shipment Number and Order Id

customAttributes.description:
Carrier specific options

Ex: RequiresDeliveryConfirmation when using usps with non-express mail service type.

externalOrderId.description:
Optional external (non-Kibo) order identifier to print on the label.
Mapped into EasyPost PrintCustom reference lines alongside ReferenceNotes
and CustomerReferences, within the 3-line carrier capacity.

fulfillmentMethod.description: Fulfillment method for the shipment. STH / Delivery. Empty will be assumed as STH.

hazmatClassification.description:
Optional hazardous-materials classification (pass-through string). Conveyed
to the carrier via EasyPost options.hazmat. The system maintains no hazmat
taxonomy; unsupported values are rejected by EasyPost and surfaced as an error.
Never inferred or defaulted.

labelFormat.description:
Returns the Label in the requested format.
Specify either "LASER" or "THERMAL" format.
Actual supported image formats vary by carrier.

referenceNotes.description:
Optional freeform reference notes to print on the label. Mapped into EasyPost
PrintCustom reference lines alongside ExternalOrderId and CustomerReferences,
within the 3-line carrier capacity. Truncated on overflow with a warning.

signatureOption.description:

All packages will inherit this option value automatically.
Set this option on the package level to override this value.
